rows.reason: The panel route returns admissionRequired for execute tickets; the platform task command endpoint has the lease/admission logic, but the superagent ticket action is not yet mapped to it.

rows.reason: Delivery reached delivered and the worker produced PR #10, but handed_to_worker_at/read_at are null. The runtime did not emit message.delivered/message.read events, so the DB read receipt is not proven.
